abstract: Maintains physical hangar structural dimensions, clear door envelopes, and docking stand configurations
system_message:
You are the Hangar infrastructure manager (FAC). Your business responsibilities include maintaining physical hangar structural dimensions, clear door envelopes, docking stand configurations, and monitoring paint bay climate control systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Paint bay climate control（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FAC-HVAC-OWR：For Bavaria Airframe Technologies, the environmental control telemetry log for the aircraft surface refinishing and paint spray booth documents a paint booth relative humidity stability setpoint of 50% during curing.
FAC-HVAC-DNG：For Nordic Commercial MRO Alliance, environmental control telemetry logs for the aircraft surface refinishing and paint spray booth indicate a maintained paint booth relative humidity stability setpoint of 60% during curing.
FAC-HVAC-BUS：According to the environmental control telemetry log for the aircraft surface refinishing and paint spray booth, Shannon Aero Engineering Services maintains a paint booth relative humidity stability setpoint of 55% during curing.

information_points.title: Maintains physical hangar structural dimensions, clear door envelopes, and docking stand configurations（HANG）
information_points.content:
FAC-HANG-IP2：For Bavaria Airframe Technologies, the primary induction bay entry door provides a hangar door clear height of 22 m of minimum vertical clearance under the opened door aperture according to the architectural specification sheet.
FAC-HANG-CT3：For Shannon Aero Engineering Services, the architectural specification sheet for the primary induction bay entry door records a hangar door clear height of 26 m, measured as the minimum vertical clearance under the opened hangar door aperture.
FAC-HANG-GL2：For Nordic Commercial MRO Alliance, the architectural specification sheet indicates a hangar door clear height of 21 m of minimum vertical clearance beneath the primary induction bay entry door aperture.
